# gyro_server_addon (Resource)

Buys an add-on for an existing service (POST /cloud/services/{id}/addons), e.g. the Network Firewall add-on that gyro_firewall and gyro_security_group need. The resource waits until the add-on is active, so a server, its firewall add-on and its firewall rules can be created in one apply: reference this resource from gyro_firewall / gyro_server_security_groups with depends_on. This spends money: on prepaid services (Gyro Cloud Istanbul, containers) the add-on is charged hourly from the balance; on invoiced services an invoice is created and paid from the balance (apply fails with the invoice link if the balance is not enough). Destroy removes prepaid add-ons at once (billing stops); invoiced add-ons cannot be cancelled through the API - destroy then only forgets them (cancel in the panel). Pick the add-on by id (addon_id / option_id) or by name (addon / option, case-insensitive, as listed by `gyro service addons available <id>` or GET /cloud/services/{id}/addons/available). Every argument is ForceNew.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# New server + Network Firewall add-on + firewall rules in one apply.
resource "gyro_server" "db" {
  plan   = "standart-2-4"
  region = "tr-ist-1"
  image  = "ubuntu-24.04"
  name   = "gyro-proje-db"

  confirm_order = true
}

# Prepaid server: the add-on is charged hourly from the balance and removed at once on destroy.
resource "gyro_server_addon" "firewall" {
  service_id = tonumber(gyro_server.db.id)
  addon      = "firewall" # or addon_id / option_id from `gyro service addons available <id>`
}

resource "gyro_firewall" "db" {
  server_id      = tonumber(gyro_server.db.id)
  default_action = "deny"

  rule {
    action      = "allow"
    protocol    = "tcp"
    port        = "22"
    source      = "203.0.113.10/32"
    description = "ssh from the office"
  }

  depends_on = [gyro_server_addon.firewall] # waits until the add-on is active
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (Number) Service (server) id.

### Optional

- `addon` (String) Add-on name instead of addon_id (case-insensitive; a unique part of the name is enough).
- `addon_id` (Number) Add-on id (from the available list). Set this or addon.
- `option` (String) Option name instead of option_id (case-insensitive; a unique part is enough).
- `option_id` (Number) Option id of the add-on. Left out: the option named by option, else the only / first option.
- `quantity` (Number) Quantity (1-100, default 1).

### Read-Only

- `billing` (String) prepaid (hourly from the balance, removable) or invoice.
- `id` (String) <service_id>/<record_id>
- `name` (String) Add-on name as shown in the panel.
- `option_name` (String) Option name as shown in the panel.
- `record_id` (Number) Add-on record id on the service.
- `removable` (Boolean) true = destroy removes it through the API (prepaid add-ons).
- `status` (String) active, waiting, suspended ... (at the last read).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <service_id>/<record_id> (record ids: gyro service addons list <id>)
terraform import gyro_server_addon.firewall 12345/9001
```
